title: openai-compat: passthrough seed/determinism + metadata for Responses API variants; streaming and tools stability fixes
author: Ava Thompson
description: This PR extends the OpenAI compatibility layer to fully support newer Responses API variants and related surface-area features used by customers: passthrough of seed and determinism flags, preservation of per-request metadata through the response envelope, improved streaming stability (backpressure and reconnect handling), and adjustments to function/tool-calling semantics to match OpenAI behavior. Motivation: several customers and internal workloads rely on deterministic sampling via seed/determinism, and metadata annotations (request_id, provenance tags) must survive the compatibility translation for observability and downstream tooling. Streaming regressions were observed during high-throughput canaries; this PR hardens the streaming path and adds targeted e2e tests. Changes include: compatibility shim updates, additions to SDK adapters, new unit/integration tests, docs updates, and CI orchestration to exercise streaming under load. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged when seed/determinism omitted; metadata passthrough is opt-in via compat flag. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated for 48h canary on dedicated before full release. Checklist: ensure unit tests and integration tests pass; run canary against perf-canary; update changelog and docs; monitor responses_metrics for errors and latency regressions.
